item.title: Bradley-Terry Model
item.description: Recently I have been attempting to rank my favorite things, including films, anime, manga, directors, artists, and so on. The cognitive overhead for a task like this is immense. Rather than trying to assign arbitrary numbers to each item and refining them down to the tenth or hundredth manually to create separation within condensed tiers, I decided to consider ranking items via paired comparisons.
